acquisition method: For the mass spectrometry, a top-ten data dependent acquisition method was employed with a dynamic exclusion time of 15 seconds and exclusion of singly charged species.
cleavage agent: 10 μL of the cross-linked mixture was digest by the addition of 10 μL trypsin/LysC mix (0.1 μg/μL - Promega) overnight at 40°C.
instrument: Protein digests were analyzed by LC/MS on a Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (ThermoFisher Scientific)
labeling: Protein digests were analyzed by LC/MS on a Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (ThermoFisher Scientific)
precursor tolerance: parent mass tolerance of 10 ppm and fragment mass tolerance of 50 ppm
fragment tolerance: parent mass tolerance of 10 ppm and fragment mass tolerance of 50 ppm
ptm: oxidation of methionine as a variable modification
